Daily run 2026-11-02 (exact Oct 29 - Nov 1; Nov 2 so far from hourly data)

Biggest change: Uber SMS shifted signature and is getting through

  • Uber SMS (Key 1): the grease/pagebio wave fell from 2.1M/day (Oct 28) to 75k on Nov 1, but it reappeared on other signatures with high verified share: pragma + upcoming-Chrome 175k on Nov 1 at 91% verified; spoofed-OS + pagebio + GREASE 42k on Nov 1 at 62% verified (8.9-13k/hour at 00-02 UTC with 6.9-12k verified per hour).
  • Discovery NEW-1 (rfc ct-before-cl + di-short-300-pxr1): 2.81M Uber SMS sessions in Oct 29 - Nov 1 at 46% verified; only 8% already flagged by a live TT. Biggest gap found this run.

Still large but blocked

  • Amazon IDS (Key 2): grease 2.05M Oct 30 / 2.76M Oct 31 / 0.94M Nov 1 and pagebio 1.2-1.6M/day at 1-3% verified. Single-click + dp-spoof 295k on Oct 30 at 55% verified, 118k on Nov 1 at 7%.
  • Highlight AI Chat Prompt: grease/pagebio 860k on Oct 31, 465k on Nov 1, 0-1% verified.
  • Roblox Login (Key 1): webgl 228k on Oct 31 at 0% verified; dishort300 + ja4 40k on Oct 31.
  • Microsoft Identity Signup: webgl ~70-90k/day at 0-1% verified.
  • Blizzard ROW Support Site: grease 11-31k/day at 0% verified.

New keys

  • Expedia EG Taap LowTraffic (Key 3): grease 48k-101k/day; got through on Oct 29-30 (75-96% verified) and fell to 6-11% on Oct 31 - Nov 1; OS-spoofing family 9k on Nov 1 at 57%.
  • Airbnb Account Lookup: grease/pagebio 43-69k/day Oct 29-31 at 0-15% verified, stopped Nov 1.
  • Chime Login (Key 1): ends-te + dp-spoof 9-13k/day Oct 31 - Nov 1 at 16-26% verified.
  • Bank of America Beacon ATM keys again: AuthHub Key 3 (519C70B3) ends-te 5k/day at 0% verified, and CashPro Key 5 (B993C75A) in discovery. Same pattern as Beacon Workforce Key 4 last week.
  • Tinder PreSMS: OS-spoofing family 1-5k/day at 79-96% verified (getting through).

Getting through (high verified)

  • gtop100: single-click 25k on Nov 1 at 97% verified; grease 36k at 72%.
  • Adobe Sign Up: grease 28k on Nov 1 at 43%; pagebio 10k at 49%; ends-te 3k at 83%.
  • Adobe ARP FF: webgl 17-33k/day at 54-68% (1% on Nov 1).

Stopped / switched off

  • Roblox Game Join ends-te (55k on Oct 27 -> 0); Roblox Login spoofed-OS wave (974k on Oct 28 -> ~4k/day); Airbnb on Nov 1; Adobe Commerce webgl (22k -> ~0).

Discovery (Oct 29 - Nov 1): 2 new candidates, validated, not created

  • g-rfc-ct-before-cl-di-short-300-pxr1: 8 keys, exact share 0.86, 4.59M sessions, 34% verified. Uber SMS 2.81M (46% verified; its NO-THREAT hits share JA4 with the bot-classified ones), Highlight AI 695k, Amazon IDS 446k, Roblox Monetization 201k (95% verified, may be benign), Expedia, Airbnb, MS Signup.

Appendix — how these were found

Daily run 2026-11-02, window Oct 29 - Nov 1 (4 full days) vs Oct 22-28, 1% SYSTEM sample. STEP 1: the stock 01 query timed out twice (identical re-send), so it was run as 4 public-key partitions (first hex char 0-3/4-7/8-B/C-F) with the same spike rule and merged (per-key spike tests add across partitions); key-level names (<acct>-h-/-e-, audit-temp, ps-temp) and the verbose events-count/bba-signature flags were excluded from the output; partition 4-7 hit its 200-row cap, so only some 1-key flags under ~11k/day excess are missing. 118 flags had >=3 spiking keys. ARTIFACT CHECK (list_telltales/get_telltale_changelog): DI dictionary revert has NOT happened - dict-1/3/neg1 still carry the -99 condition and every global g-di-dict-* was last edited 2026-10-27 02:06-04:16 by m.davies (no edits since), so no revert jump is inside the window; dict-7/15/31 (re-thresholded Oct 27, last 2 baseline days) still dropped per the Oct 28 decision (they show 3-5 spiking keys only because of the mixed-definition baseline). CHNGE-6738: none of g-cdn-pragma-sec-ch-ua-upcoming-chrome, g-spoofed-os-mismatch-pagebio-null-grease, g-di-dict3-st-1x-di-short-300-pxr1, g-os-spoofing-pagebio-null exist in Dataswan (not created); key-level copies created inside the window: roblox2-h-di-dict3-st-1x-di-short-300-pxr1 (2026-10-29 20:12, BLUE-7310), msidentity2-h-di-dict3-st-1x-di-short-300-pxr1 (2026-10-29 19:52, BLUE-7309), adobe2-h-rfc-ct-before-cl-device-param-spoofing-di-dict3-st-1x (2026-10-29 18:57, BLUE-7312) - key-level, excluded. Dropped: cdn-header-order-only-have-single-cookie (6 keys; created Oct 24, baseline ~0); country-timezone-mismatch / g--e-country-timezone-mismatch / country-match-timezone-mismatch-no-vpn (4 keys; DST); ja4-dict-1-challenger(+not-included dup) (6 keys; Oct 27 step change); wired velocity 1point5x (3 keys); Ensemble lists (g--e-*); g-atm-all-agents-generated and g-atm-ai-agent-generated (5 keys each; both CREATED 2026-10-29 23:35/23:56 inside the window, names enter from 0); g-di-dict-7 1x/4x, dict-15 1x/4x, dict-31 1x/4x (definition change Oct 27); g-os-impersonation-appleos-device-param-spoofing-sec-fetch-dest (created Oct 30) and g-biometric-mouse-exact-replay-above-2-events-4plus (created Nov 1) did not reach >=3 keys and are excluded anyway. timezone-anomaly-usa (5 keys) was NOT dropped: not edited since 2024 and concentrated on the attack keys (Amazon IDS 1.13M/day vs 99k, Highlight AI 148k vs 3k), not a broad US DST step.
